subject: hashtable: disallow insert during safe iteration (fixes #2302) (#3796)
reason: The change adds an internal invariant assertion (assert(ht->safe_iterators == NULL) in hashtable.c's insert()), a doc rewrite, and a rewritten unit test. It forbids inserting into a hashtable during safe iteration; delete/replace are unchanged. No command-reachable path in this build violates the invariant: every HASHTABLE_ITER_SAFE caller (KEYS, DEBUG DIGEST, rdbSaveDb, pubsub unsubscribe, vset expiry, module/latency command listings, kvstore) only reads/deletes/replaces during iteration and never inserts; dict.c safe iterators are a separate structure untouched by the change; there is no for
